# Villa Kukkapää – historic lakeside villa on Lake Saimaa, Sulkava, Finland

Vekarantie 462, 58700 Sulkava, Finland. Owner: Pentti Parkkinen, +358 400 312 802, pentti.parkkinen@fimnet.fi
(also Kirsi, +358 400 760 448). Under 40 km from Savonlinna, 330 km from Helsinki.
Book through Lomarengas: https://www.lomarengas.fi/mokit/sulkava-villa-kukkapaa-13347

## The villa
250 m² villa built in 1904, renovated in 2012, once the head office of the Kukkapää sawmill. Sleeps 10.
Big kitchen with a cooking island, dining table for 10, tiled stove and open fireplace (firewood included), library,
children's playroom, TV room, 2 toilets and 2 showers, air-source heat pump, internet. Open all year.

## Lakeside sauna house
90 m² sauna house right on the lake. Wood-fired AitoKiuas and an electric stove, dining and lounge for 10,
kitchenette, fireplace, terrace, beds for 4 more. Winterised.

## Beach and grounds
Over 200 m of private, gently sloping sand beach that suits small children. Pier, rowing boat, canoe, bikes,
grass field for volleyball and badminton, garden pavilion and grill. 20,000 m² grounds with a wooden fence.
Small pets welcome. No smoking indoors.

## Extras
Linen set €30 per person, final cleaning €200, electric outboard €100 per week, petrol outboard €130 per week.

## Nearby
Vilkaharju esker and nature trails (about 2 km), Hopeasaari circuit and grill hut, Rauhaniemi museum area,
Sulkava rowing stadium, Tiittala manor shore café, Sulkava disc golf course.

## History
The Blomqvist family lived in the sawmill manager's house from 1922 to 1951. The sawmill ran from 1904 to 1951.
